Platform android-36 is not installed but android-36.1 is, so app/build.gradle uses compileSdkVersion 'android-36.1' instead of installing a platform. (4) Room 2.6.0 kapt fails under Kotlin 2.4.20 with 'Unable to read Kotlin metadata due to unsupported metadata kind', so Room is raised to 2.8.5 (developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/room), still on kapt.
